extracts.text:
scheduleResponse.games.filter(
                  (game: any) =>
                    game.gameType === 2 &&
                    game.gameDate.split("T")[0] >= startDate &&
                    game.gameDate.split("T")[0] <= goalieEndDate,
                ).length

goalieData.map(
                    (goalie: any) => {
                      const advancedStats = advancedStatsMap[goalie.playerId];
                      return {
                        playerId: goalie.playerId,
                        goalieFullName: goalie.goalieFullName,
                        lastName: goalie.lastName,
                        gamesPlayed: goalie.gamesPlayed,
                        gamesStarted: goalie.gamesStarted,
                        wins: goalie.wins,
                        losses: goalie.losses,
                        otLosses: goalie.otLosses,
                        savePct: goalie.savePct,
                        gaa: goalie.goalsAgainstAverage,
                        shutouts: goalie.shutouts,
                        workloadShare:
                          completedGames > 0
                            ? (goalie.gamesStarted / completedGames) * 100
                            : 0,
                        qualityStarts: advancedStats?.qualityStart || 0,
                        qualityStartsPct: advancedStats?.qualityStartsPct || 0,
                      };
                    },
                  )

goalieData.reduce(
                    (acc: any, goalie: any) => {
                      const advancedStats = advancedStatsMap[goalie.playerId];
                      return {
                        gamesPlayed: acc.gamesPlayed + goalie.gamesPlayed,
                        wins: acc.wins + goalie.wins,
                        losses: acc.losses + goalie.losses,
                        otLosses: acc.otLosses + goalie.otLosses,
                        saves: acc.saves + goalie.saves,
                        shotsAgainst: acc.shotsAgainst + goalie.shotsAgainst,
                        goalsAgainst: acc.goalsAgainst + goalie.goalsAgainst,
                        shutouts: acc.shutouts + goalie.shutouts,
                        qualityStarts:
                          acc.qualityStarts +
                          (advancedStats?.qualityStart || 0),
                        timeOnIce: acc.timeOnIce + goalie.timeOnIce,
                      };
                    },
                    {
                      gamesPlayed: 0,
                      wins: 0,
                      losses: 0,
                      otLosses: 0,
                      saves: 0,
                      shotsAgainst: 0,
                      goalsAgainst: 0,
                      shutouts: 0,
                      qualityStarts: 0,
                      timeOnIce: 0,
                    },
                  )

teamTotals.shotsAgainst > 0
                      ? teamTotals.saves / teamTotals.shotsAgainst
                      : 0

teamTotals.timeOnIce > 0
                      ? (teamTotals.goalsAgainst * 3600) / teamTotals.timeOnIce
                      : 0

goalie.qualityStartsPct
                                  ? formatPercentage(goalie.qualityStartsPct)
                                  : "N/A"
currentTeamData.goals_for || 0
currentTeamData.goals_against || 0
currentTeamData.games_played || 1
goalsForSafe / gamesPlayedSafe
goalsAgainstSafe / gamesPlayedSafe
goalsForSafe - goalsAgainstSafe

allTeamsSummary
                    .filter(
                      (team) => team.games_played && team.games_played > 0,
                    )
                    .map(
                      (team) =>
                        (team.goals_for || 0) / (team.games_played || 1),
                    )

allTeamsSummary
                    .filter(
                      (team) => team.games_played && team.games_played > 0,
                    )
                    .map(
                      (team) =>
                        (team.goals_against || 0) / (team.games_played || 1),
                    )

(rows: MobileLeaderRow[], index: number) =>
  rows.findIndex((row) => row.rankValue === rows[index].rankValue) + 1

allTeamsSummary
                    .map((team) => team.power_play_pct || 0)
                    .filter((pct) => pct > 0)

(value: unknown): value is number =>
  typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)
(scoreGames?.dates ?? []).slice(0, recentGameCount).reverse()

scoreDates.length === recentGameCount &&
    row.source_through_date !== null &&
    scoreDates[scoreDates.length - 1] === row.source_through_date &&
    scoreGames?.seasonGameCount != null &&
    scoreGames.seasonGameCount === countOrNull(row.source_game_count)
scoreDatesConfirmed ? scoreDates : []
gameRows.slice(0, recentGameCount)
windowRows.map((game) => game.date).reverse()

scoreDatesConfirmed &&
    puckDates.length === scoreDates.length &&
    puckDates.every((date, index) => date === scoreDates[index])
